Container.Name: jellyfin-discord-presence
Container.Overview: Headless Discord Rich Presence for Jellyfin. Polls the Jellyfin API for what the chosen user is playing and shows it on your Discord profile using your user token (no Discord client required). Supports per-library and per-media-type exclusions. NOTE: driving a user account this way is a self-bot and violates Discord's Terms of Service; use at your own risk.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_URL
Config.Description: Internal address the container uses to reach Jellyfin. On the homelab bridge the container name resolves, so http://Jellyfin:8096 works.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_API_KEY
Config.Description: Jellyfin Dashboard -> API Keys -> +. Needs admin scope to read /Sessions.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: The Jellyfin account whose playback to mirror.

Config.Name: DISCORD_USER_TOKEN
Config.Description: Your Discord user token (self-bot). Browser -> discord.com -> F12 -> Network -> any /api/ request -> 'authorization' header. Keep secret.

Config.Name: DISCORD_APP_ID
Config.Description: Discord Developer Portal -> your Application -> Application ID. Used for the activity name and art assets.

Config.Name: EXCLUDE_LIBRARIES
Config.Description: Comma-separated library names to hide (exactly as shown in Jellyfin), e.g. Anime,Home Videos.

Config.Name: EXCLUDE_MEDIA_TYPES
Config.Description: Comma-separated categories to hide: movie, episode (tv/shows), music (audio), musicvideo, livetv, book, trailer.

Config.Name: JELLYFIN_PUBLIC_URL
Config.Description: Optional. Public HTTPS Jellyfin URL (your reverse-proxy domain) so Discord can fetch poster art. Leave blank for a static logo.

Config.Name: SHOW_PAUSED
Config.Description: Keep the presence up (no progress bar) while paused.

Config.Name: STATIC_LARGE_IMAGE
Config.Description: Art-asset key (uploaded under Developer Portal -> Rich Presence -> Art Assets) used when poster art is unavailable.

Config.Name: SMALL_IMAGE_PLAYING
Config.Description: Optional small badge art-asset key for the playing state.

Config.Name: SMALL_IMAGE_PAUSED
Config.Description: Optional small badge art-asset key for the paused state.
